title: Memory agreement after a sequence of effects
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, $s\subseteq\mathbb Z$ a set of memory addresses, $l$ a finite list of instructions, and $m$ a memory assigning a $W$-bit word to each integer address. If every instruction in $l$ satisfies the condition that it writes in $s$, then applying the effects of the instructions in order leaves $m$ unchanged at every address outside $s$.
hypotheses_covered: Every instruction in $l$ satisfies the condition that it writes in $s$
